# Diagnostic codes: wiring area

Codes `WIRE-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` emitted by `src/core/src/wiring/` (owner: WIRE,
`openspec/changes/m2-interactive-editing/design.md` D1/D2). Conventions and
the renderings are described in [../codes.md](../codes.md).

The table below is generated from `src/core/src/wiring/codes.cpp`:

```sh
hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=wiring
```

The unit test `each area's code table matches its document and prefix`
fails when the two disagree.

<!-- BEGIN DIAGNOSTIC CODES (generated by `hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=wiring`) -->
| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `WIRE-CMD-001` | error | Bad `wire` option or arguments (the help list or the option's syntax follows). |
| `WIRE-CMD-002` | error | A layer name given to `wire` does not exist or is ambiguous. |
| `WIRE-CMD-003` | error | No wiring material: none selected yet, none visible under the cursor, or no usable cursor. |
| `WIRE-CMD-004` | error | The box (or the edit cell) needed to start a leg or place a contact is missing. |
| `WIRE-CMD-005` | error | No contact can be placed: same layer, no wiring contact, or no routing layer. |
| `WIRE-CMD-006` | warning | `wire increment type` or `wire decrement type` found several routing layers; the first in search order is used. |
| `WIRE-FILE-001` | error | The `wire segment` coordinate file cannot be found or opened. |
| `WIRE-FILE-002` | error | A line of the `wire segment` coordinate file lacks a coordinate. |
| `WIRE-PATH-001` | warning | A `wire segment` path reverses direction or repeats a point; it is split there. |
| `WIRE-PATH-002` | warning | A `wire segment` bend exceeds the mitre limit; the route is truncated there. |
| `WIRE-REPORT-001` | info | A report or note `wire` prints while it runs (Magic's TxPrintf text). |
| `WIRE-REPORT-002` | warning | A warning `wire` prints while it still runs (Magic's TxError text). |
| `WIRE-TECH-001` | warning | A line of the `wiring` technology section has an error and was ignored. |
<!-- END DIAGNOSTIC CODES -->
